Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.managers

package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.managers
Classes that run the game, including the timer, geese, waves, hidden events and debug tools.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol
    Entry point of the game, which opens the title screen.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.components
    Building blocks used by the game, such as the map, item data, hidden events, waves, sounds and the student controller.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities
    Objects that exist in the game world: the student, geese, items and projectiles, all based on Entity.
    io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.screens
    The game's screens: title, setup, settings, gameplay and end screen.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DebugManager
    DebugManager is a tool created specifically for development to keep track of collisions, add debugs tools to speed up testing, and track performance
    GameManager
    GameManager is the class that manages most aspects of the gameplay itself, keeping track of Geese through GooseManager, the student using Student, etc.
    GooseManager
    GooseManager manages the geese that appear in the game, storing them as an Array of Goose.
    HiddenEventManager
    HiddenEventManager controls when hidden events (HiddenEvent) get triggered and keeps track of how many are triggers, which ones are left to be triggered
    WaveManager
    WaveManager controls the waves mechanic of the game, handling timings and the placement of geese for each wave.
